title: His brother follows to California but leaves music
summary: Howard says his younger brother came to California about a year after him but stayed out of music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: He talked about coming to California so did your brother come with you or who did you come with.
I came with my -- no, I came by myself.
No, I came by myself. My brother didn't come over here for about a year later than I did.
But he did come to California.?
Was your brother younger or older.?
Did he play in Los Angeles.?
Did he stay with music like you did?

No, he didn't stay with music. He was too busy, I don't know, fooling around with others things. You wouldn't be interested in this anyhow, because he got his mind off of music and went on to something else.
